Industries

Owner-led service businesses across every industry.

The problems we solve are the same across verticals — missed leads, weak follow-up, no documented processes, and an owner who is the bottleneck. The systems we build are customized to how your business actually works.

💆

Med Spas

The Pain

Leads come from Instagram DMs, web forms, phone calls, and referrals — and fall through constantly. Follow-up is manual. Appointment no-shows aren't followed up on. The owner is fielding every question.

After OwnerOS AI

Unified lead intake, instant AI-assisted response, appointment reminder sequences, reactivation campaigns for lapsed clients, and a weekly owner dashboard.

🔨

Contractors & Remodelers

The Pain

Estimates go out and disappear. Follow-up happens when someone remembers. There's no system for tracking where each job is. The owner is the only one who knows what's happening.

After OwnerOS AI

Estimate follow-up sequences, lead source tracking, project status board, recurring job checklists, and a field-to-office communication system.

🦷

Dental Offices

The Pain

Front desk is overwhelmed. New patient inquiries aren't followed up on consistently. Insurance verification takes forever. There's no SOP for how anything gets done.

After OwnerOS AI

New patient inquiry workflow, appointment reminder sequences, insurance intake checklist, front desk SOP library, and an AI-assisted phone script.

🏠

Roofing & HVAC

The Pain

Seasonal lead spikes are mismanaged. Estimates pile up with no follow-up system. Crews don't know where they're supposed to be. The owner is the dispatcher, salesperson, and QA manager.

After OwnerOS AI

Lead intake and routing, estimate follow-up automation, crew scheduling checklist, customer communication templates, and a job pipeline dashboard.

⚖️

Law Firms

The Pain

Intake is inconsistent. Prospective clients don't hear back fast enough. Matter status isn't visible to anyone but the partner. Billing follow-up is manual and awkward.

After OwnerOS AI

Intake form workflow, prospect response system, matter status tracking, billing reminder templates, and a client communication guide (with attorney review).

🏡

Real Estate Teams

The Pain

Leads go cold fast. Every agent handles follow-up differently. There's no consistent client communication process. The team leader has no visibility into pipeline health.

After OwnerOS AI

Lead response sequences, agent follow-up playbook, buyer/seller communication templates, pipeline dashboard, and weekly team summary.

🎓

Training Schools

The Pain

Enrollment inquiries aren't followed up consistently. Student communication is scattered. Staff don't have standard answers to common questions. The director manages everything manually.

After OwnerOS AI

Enrollment inquiry workflow, student communication templates, FAQ knowledge base, staff training guides, and an enrollment pipeline dashboard.

Professional Services

The Pain
